programme.title: Sue Casa, His Casa
programme.desc: Al cancels his auto insurance and the kids get into an auto accident

programme.title: The Unnatural
programme.desc: Al's pride is on the line when his softball team threatens to bench him right before the league championship

programme.title: Dance Show
programme.desc: Peg meets a charming married man and his jealous "husband" shows up on the Bundy's doorstep

programme.title: Kelly Bounces Back
programme.desc: Kelly sets her sights on becoming a car showroom model

programme.title: Married...with Aliens
programme.desc: Al is visited by mysterious green creatures who creep into his bedroom and take his dirty socks

programme.title: Wabbit Season
programme.desc: A stressed-out Al takes up gardening for relaxation but ends up battling a pesky rabbi

programme.title: Do Ya Think I'm Sexy?
programme.sub-title: S5:E9 Do Ya Think I'm Sexy? (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: Peggy becomes worried when the neighborhood women suddenly find Al irresitible

programme.title: One Down Two To Go
programme.sub-title: S5:E10 One Downm Two To Go (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: Peggy goes off the deep end when Kelly decides to leave the nest and get an apartment of her own

programme.title: And Baby Makes Money
programme.desc: Al and Peggy stand to inherit a fortune by producing another Bundy baby.

programme.title: Married...With Who
programme.desc: Marcy wakes up to discover a man in her bed and a wedding ring on her finger.

programme.title: Look Who's Barking
programme.desc: Buck, the Dog, fed up with the Bundys neglect, decides to leave home and venture out into the world.

programme.title: Godfather
programme.desc: Al entertains notions of greatness when he discovers Kelly's new boyfriend is an influential politician.

programme.title: A Man's Castle
programme.desc: Peg enrolls in an interior design course and chooses the Bundy home and Al's domain - the bathroom, as her first project.

programme.title: All-Night Security Dude
programme.desc: The shoe store gives Al the boot so he takes a job as night security at Polk High School and comes face-to-face with his high school rival, who wants to even the score.

programme.title: Angel in Love
programme.desc: Sabrina falls in love with one Doug O'Neal, at Utopia West, a resort where people go "to learn how to touch and feel."

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels On The Air
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angel Baby
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels In The Wings
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Permanent House Guest
programme.desc: Jeannie is disappointed that Tony has never asked for anything big, like a yacht.

programme.title: Bigger Than A Bread Box And Better Than A Genie
programme.desc: Madam Zolta, a fortuneteller, impresses Roger with her knowledge of his past.

programme.title: My Master, The Great Rembrandt
programme.desc: The astronauts paint pictures to be auctioned off at the Air Force Benefit Show.

programme.title: My Master, The Thief
programme.desc: Nostalgia grips Jeannie when she learns the local museum is showing an exhibit from Bukistan, her old home.

programme.title: This Is Murder
programme.desc: Tony is assigned to assure Princess Tarji a good time during her three-day visit to the country, since the US is anxious to make a deal for oil with her father, the Shah of Pakuait.

programme.title: My Master, The Magician
programme.desc: Jeannie brings dinner to Tony's office. Overhearing Tony and Jeannie late at night, Dr. Bellows tells General Peterson Tony is having an orgy.

programme.title: I'll Never Forget What's Her Name
programme.desc: Tony receives a letter asking him to escort Miss Gordon around Cocoa Beach.

programme.title: Happy Anniversary
programme.desc: Jeannie wants to celebrate the first anniversary of meeting Tony on the desert island where they met. Preparing for a space flight, Tony forgets the date. Annoyed, Jeannie makes his capsule land on the island where Tony finds a bottle.

programme.title: Always On Sunday
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie it's too bad every day can't be Sunday. Feeling Tony is overworked, Jeannie blinks and it becomes Sunday. She tells a horrified Tony it will be Sunday until he is rested.

programme.title: My Master, The Rich Tycoon
programme.sub-title: S2:E33 My Master, The Rich Tycoon (EN-DE)
programme.desc: While Tony is at the Base, Harry Huggins comes to his nose. He tells Jeannie the house is tiny and the furniture shoddy. To impress him, Jeannie blinks and turns the house into a luxurious mansion, with world famous art works, a safe full of money and a staff of servants.

programme.title: My Master, The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie he enjoys cold weather. She starts a snowstorm and the flakes fall on Dr. Bellows. Determined to discover the explanation for the strange happenings around Tony, Dr. Bellows tells Gen. Peterson

programme.title: My Wild-eyed Master
programme.desc: Tony strains his eyes while studying for a sub-orbital flight. Dr. Bellows orders him to take an eye test the following morning. Tony emphatically turns down Roger's suggestion that he get Jeannie's help in passing the examination.

programme.title: What's New Poodle Dog
programme.desc: Roger tells Jeannie that he has arranged a double date for Tony and himself with two beauty queens. Before Roger can tell Tony, Jeannie turns him into a French poodle. The poodle is taken to the dog pound. There, Tony pays five dollars for a Great Dane he thinks is Roger.

programme.title: Fastest Gun In The East
programme.sub-title: S2:E37 Fastest Gun in the East (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Watching a TV western, Tony longs for the days when a man had to be strong to survive. Jeannie blinks and Tony finds he is a U.S. Marshal in a frontier town. Confronted by a bang of outlaws led by Bull Welch, Tony is saved by Horace Sedgewick, the town banker.

programme.title: How To Be A Genie In 10 Easy Lessons
programme.sub-title: S2:E38 How To Be a Genie in 10 Easy Lessons (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Tony complains that Jeannie is constantly getting him into trouble. She replies she's not had much practice at being a genie. Tony takes Roger's suggestion that Jeannie needs lessors in her craft and buys "The Arabian Nights."

programme.title: Who Needs A Green-Eyed Genie
programme.sub-title: S2:E39 Who Needs a Green-Eyed Genie? (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Jeannie's jealousy takes over when Tony insists on keeping a date with a friend. She blinks and Tony finds himself behind bars in his living room. Feeling she has been successful in keeping Tony from his date, she releases him the following morning.

programme.title: The Girl Who Never Had A Birthday, Pt. 1
programme.sub-title: S2:E40 The Girl Who Had Never Had a Birthday - Part 1 (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Jeannie tells Tony she never had a birthday party since she does not know when she was born. Tony sends her back home to find out. At the base, Gen. Peterson and Dr. Bellows introduce Tony to Eric, a huge computer.

programme.title: The Girl Who Never Had A Birthday, Pt. 2
programme.sub-title: S2:E41 The Girl Who Had Never Had a Birthday - Part 2 (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Tony and Roger make another attempt to have Eric, the com-puter figure out Jeannie's birthday. Since Tony is scheduled to leave for Alaska on a mission, Dr. Bellows uses Tony' s office while his own is being painted.

programme.title: How Do You Beat Superman
programme.sub-title: S2:E42 How Do You Beat Superman? (EN-DE)
programme.desc: With the football season in full swing, Tony is constantly glued to the TV set. Jeannie realizes she must do something to get his attention and decides to make Tony jealous.

programme.title: My Master, The Great Caruso
programme.sub-title: S2:E43 My Master, The Great Caruso (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie that each year the American Air Force puts on a TV talent show with contestants from each base. Jeannie insists that Tony enter since they need a trophy for the mantle.

programme.title: The Greatest Lover In The World
programme.sub-title: S2:E44 The Greatest Lover in the World (EN-DE)
programme.desc: Roger cancels a double date with Tony and Jeannie. Surmising that Roger has been unable to get a date for himself, Jeannie blinks. Immediately Roger's phone gets busy with calls from girls who turned him down, and a score of new ones, begging for dates.

programme.title: Jeannie Breaks The Bank
programme.desc: Because Jeannie has run up a staggering food bill, Tony is unable to join Roger in buying a sailboat. Jeannie goes to the bank with Tony to borrow money for his share.

programme.title: My Master, The Author
programme.desc: Tony complains that he has no free time because Jeannie waits him to spend every spare moment with her. Roger suggests he find Jeannie a hobby, but she turns down all his suggestions, until she mentions that she could write a book on raising children.

programme.title: Weenie Tot Lovers And Other Strangers
programme.sub-title: S5:E17 Weenie Tot Lovers And Other Strangers (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: Peg and Al must decide whether to give their last hundred dollars to Bud, who's been selected a top teen or to Kelly, who's got a chance to become "Miss Weenie Tot.

programme.title: Oldies But Young 'Uns
programme.desc: Al enlists his "oldies expert" pal, Charlie to help him to remeber a favorite song from his past, while Charlie's son Vinnie falls for Kelly.

programme.title: You Better Shop Around - Part I
programme.sub-title: S5:E19 You Better Shop Around - Part I (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: In the first of two parts, Al buys a shoddy air conditioner and causes the neighborhood to blackout, leaving the Bundys to seek refuge from the heat and their angry neighbors by taking up residence at the supermarket.

programme.title: You Better Shop Around - Part II
programme.sub-title: S5:E20 You Better Shop Around - Part II (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: When the Bundys are evicted from their temporary residence at the supermarket, Al inadvertently becomes their one millionth customer and it's a battle between the Bundys and D'Arcys for the grand prize. Special guest Jerry Mathers plays himself as the market's embarrassed celebrity host.

programme.title: Kids! Wadaya Gonna Do?
programme.desc: In need of cold cash for hot prospects, Bud and Kelly find creative ways to earn money, while a disgruntled Peg shares an uneventful evening of videos with Al and the D'Arcys.

programme.title: Route 666 - Part I
programme.desc: When Al takes the family on a road trip to a shoe convention in California, the Bundys discover a golden opportunity when their car breaks down in the middle of a ghost town.

programme.title: Route 666 - Part II
programme.desc: The California Coast will have wait when, stranded in a ghost town, the Bundys and the D'Arcys catch "gold fever" and become wary mining partners.

programme.title: Buck The Stud
programme.desc: Buck the Dog has romantic designs on every bitch in the neighborhood, but dashes Peg & Al's hopes of becoming wealthy breeders when he refuses to court a pampered pedigree.

programme.title: Top Of The Heap
programme.desc: Al loses his television set on a neighborhood boxing bet; even so, he, along with the boxer's dad, advise defeated fighter Vinnie to marry rich and forget about a career.

programme.title: She's Having My Baby (Part 1)
programme.desc: Al is unpleasantly surprised when Peg announces she's pregnant

programme.title: She's Having My Baby (Part 2)
programme.desc: Al decides to run away from home when a pregnant Peg becomes demanding.

programme.title: If Al Had A Hammer
programme.sub-title: S6:E3 If Al Had A Hammer (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: Al builds a private clubhouse to escape, but discovers there are many miserable fathers-to-be who wish to join him.

programme.title: Cheese, Cues And Blood
programme.desc: Al discovers that Kelly's making money the old fashion way - hustling pool.

programme.title: Lookin' Fer A Desk In All The Wrong Places
programme.sub-title: S6:E5 Lookin' Fer A Desk In All The Wrong Places (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: Al and Jefferson search for a "maid" while their pregnant wives are shopping.

programme.title: Buck Has A Belly Ache
programme.sub-title: S6:E6 Buck Has A Belly Ache (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: Peg feels left out when everyone's attention turns to a distraught Buck.

programme.title: If I Could See Me Now
programme.sub-title: S6:E7 If I Could See Me Now (EN-IT-ES)
programme.desc: Al gets glasses -- and only wishes they were rose colored.

programme.title: God's Shoes
programme.desc: Al has a divine inspiration and feels it is his duty to manufacture and mass market "God's shoes.

programme.title: Magic Fire
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in "Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: Jimmy visits an old friend and takes up a new pastime; Chuck and Hamlin spar over the future of the firm; and Kim faces challenges at work.

programme.title: Lantern
programme.desc: In the Season 3 finale, Kim takes time off, while Jimmy tries to make amends; Nacho gambles with his future; and Hamlin pushes Chuck to make a decision.

programme.title: Smoke
programme.desc: In the Season 4 premiere, Jimmy struggles to cope with Chuck's tragic death; Mike ponders his role at Madrigal; and Howard makes a startling confession.

programme.title: Breathe
programme.desc: Jimmy seeks new employment. Gus navigates the fallout from Hector's collapse. Kim endeavors to support Jimmy in the wake of Chuck's death.

programme.title: Something Beautiful
programme.desc: Jimmy puts a risky plan into motion. As alliances shift, Nacho finds himself in the crosshairs. Kim contemplates her future.

programme.title: Talk
programme.desc: A restless Jimmy embarks on a new endeavor while Mike burns bridges. Kim pursues her bliss. Nacho tries to survive a turf war.

programme.title: Quite a Ride
programme.desc: Jimmy identifies a new market for his talents. Mike vets a potential partnership. Kim drives a hard bargain.

programme.title: What It Means To You
programme.sub-title: S2:E20 What It Means To You
programme.desc: As they square off in court over the city's efforts to condemn a church property, Nick and Lulu carry on a clandestine sexual affair in the most unusual places.

programme.title: Burton & Earnie
programme.desc: Burton presses charges after his teenaged nephew attempts to rape Shannon.

programme.title: Sensitive Jackals
programme.desc: As Nick and Burton square off over the hiring of a new partner, a new client's custody case leads James to conclude that he beat up the wrong man in retaliation for his nephew Levi's murder.

programme.title: All The Rage
programme.desc: As Nick struggles with the possibility of Lulu leaving and James wrestles with his guilt over having beaten the wrong man, Burton is forced into a custody battle with Shannon's estranged father.

programme.title: Legacy
programme.desc: As Nick works to help the son of a workplace killer, Burton is asked to help the son of the company's murdered founder become CEO.

programme.title: Lolita?
programme.desc: Nick is assigned to represent a pregnant fifteen-year-old who has accused her stepfather of rape.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: Suspecting a U.S. Senator of being responsible for a woman's disappearance, FBI Agent Brooke Haslett follows the trail to Indianapolis where she's paired with a young psychic capable of finding missing persons.

programme.title: They Come As They Go
programme.desc: Despite all the evidence pointing to his guilt, Jess doesn't believe that the boyfriend of a missing FBI agent is responsible for her kidnapping.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: Just when Brooke needs her to find a kidnap victim who is in danger of dying, Jess finds her ability to dream being blocked by a painful memory.

programme.title: I Thought I Knew You
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of a married couple, Brooke finds that one of them may be a fugitive wanted for a deadly botched bank robbery twenty-five-years ago.

programme.title: Thin Air
programme.desc: Jess is sent to North Carolina to help find a woman who disappeared from an aircraft seemingly in-flight.

programme.title: Never Go Against The Family
programme.desc: The death of a powerful Cleveland organized crime boss draws Jess into a potentially deadly search for the mobster's missing wife.

programme.title: This Is Your Life
programme.desc: The search for a bone marrow donor sends Brooke and Jess looking for a man who has disappeared from the witness protection program.

programme.title: Reunion
programme.desc: The success of Nick's lawsuit against a pharmaceutical company depends on a young boy accusing his father of murder; James tries to keep an eleven-year-old from following his mom and older brother into prison.

programme.title: The Men From The Boys
programme.sub-title: S1:E3 The Men From The Boys
programme.desc: Nick tries to get a gay teen adopted by a gay couple; Amanda takes the lead in defending a philandering executive against a sexual harassment lawsuit.

programme.title: Paternity
programme.desc: Nick fights to have a disabled boy placed with his ex-con stepfather; the Fallins are drawn into a proxy fight that could tear apart a family they have long represented.

programme.title: Indian Summer
programme.desc: A teenage runaway coerces Nick into helping keep her and a younger sister from being separated; Alvin faces the loss of funding for his legal services clinic.

programme.title: Feeding Frenzy
programme.desc: A car accident leaves Jake facing a possible jail term; a mother seeks to keep her mentally disabled son from being exploited by a drug dealer.

programme.title: Heart
programme.desc: Nick offers to adopt a twelve-year-old heart transplant candidate.

programme.title: Funnies
programme.desc: Nick reluctantly takes on the D.A. who prosecuted him when Barbara's son is arrested for possession.

programme.title: Piñata
programme.desc: While Jimmy daydreams about reconstituting Wexler-McGill, Kim sets out to secure her own future. Mike puts a plan into motion for Gus.

programme.title: Something Stupid
programme.desc: Jimmy expands his business, but runs into a problem that only Kim can solve. Gus intervenes in Hector's medical care. Mike deals with a setback.

programme.title: Coushatta
programme.desc: Kim und Jimmy scheuen keine Mühen, um die Bezirksstaatsanwältin Ericsen und Richter Munsinger von Huells „Unschuld“ zu überzeugen. Jimmy plagt jedoch das schlechte Gewissen, da er Kim wieder mal mit in seine zwielichtigen Angelegenheiten reingezogen hat. Doch zu seiner großen Überraschung hat sie die ganze Aktion sehr genossen...

programme.title: Wiedersehen
programme.desc: Jimmy and Kim unburden themselves, risking their relationship in the process. Nacho is forced to make the rounds with Lalo. Mike has cause to worry.

programme.title: Winner
programme.desc: Jimmy turns the page on his reputation. Lalo tracks a loose end in Gus' operation. Mike is forced to make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Magic Man
programme.desc: Now doing business as “Saul Goodman,” Jimmy unveils an unorthodox strategy for client development that tests Kim’s tolerance of his new legal persona. Lalo searches for the mysterious “Michael,” only to discover a problem within his own operation.

programme.title: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Brook leaves no stone unturned while investigating the disappearance of Eric's close friend, a former Russian mail order bride.

programme.title: M.I.A.
programme.desc: The search for a fugitive soldier thought to have died seventeen years ago leads Brooke and Jess into the middle of a Bolivian drug smuggling ring.

programme.title: 72 Hours To Kill
programme.desc: Brooke puts her career on the line in order to save an innocent man from being executed for murder.

programme.title: Deliverance From Evil
programme.desc: Word of a wealthy couple's disappearance sends Brooke and Jess deep into a remote wilderness area to find them and their Eco-terrorist kidnappers.

programme.title: Victoria
programme.desc: A depressed schizophrenic's disappearance puts an innocent boy in danger as it threatens to expose a psychiatrist's role in a patient's death.

programme.title: White Whale
programme.desc: A brilliant serial killer returns to seek revenge against Brooke for being sent to prison.

programme.title: Basic Training
programme.desc: Jess goes undercover at a prestigious military academy to investigate the disappearance of a new cadet.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: The disappearance of a prominent biochemist who holds the key to a valuable weight loss drug brings Brooke face-to-face with her estranged father.

programme.title: Lost Sister
programme.desc: With Jess working on an undercover sting with Burgess, Brooke worries that an old friend at the Bureau may be behind a controversial author's kidnapping.

programme.title: Delusional
programme.desc: Following the disappearance of Brianna Norton, Jess's disturbing dream about the twenty-eight-year-old woman leads the FBI to Philadelphia.

programme.title: These Dreams Before Me
programme.desc: A facts driven no nonsense FBI agent assigned to missing-persons cases is reluctantly paired with a teen girl psychic whose visions show clues to the location of the missing.

programme.title: Sea Of Love
programme.desc: A teenaged girl's disappearance moves Jess from the Academy to partnering with Special Agent Nicole Scott.

programme.title: One Night Stand
programme.desc: Jess and Nicole investigate the disappearance of a woman who they suspect may be involved in an elaborate -- and deadly, embezzlement scheme.

programme.title: Judgement Day
programme.desc: A noted Russian mobster's pre-trial hearing leads to the kidnapping of an innocent girl.

programme.title: Loyalties
programme.desc: As Nick represents an Arab American who is being sued for defending his restaurant against a vandal's attack, Burton must face a flurry of possible defections from the firm, including his own son.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: As Nick tries to reunite a twelve-year-old boy with a schizophrenic dad who murdered his wife, Alvin represents his ex-wife in a lawsuit being argued by Burton.

programme.title: Causality
programme.desc: Moving to a new law firm starts Nick him on a downhill slide; Alvin represents the daughter of a woman he regrets defending years ago.

programme.title: Privilege
programme.desc: Nick suspects a longtime client of sexually abusing his daughter.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: As Nick takes responsibility for a troubled teenage cousin, Burton is forced to confront some unpleasant memories of his late wife.

programme.title: In Loco Parentis
programme.desc: A drug addicted mother takes her baby hostage in an effort to keep the infant from being taken away.

programme.title: Solidarity
programme.desc: As James represents a nephew being tried for the shooting death of his mom's abusive boyfriend, Nick's plans to make his feelings about Lulu clear are sidetracked by some unexpected arrivals.

programme.title: 50% Off
programme.desc: Jimmy’s promotional stunt has unintended consequences. Nacho takes extreme measures to earn Lalo’s trust. “Saul” is a success at the courthouse, but still has yet to win Kim over. Simmering with rage and self-loathing, Mike loses his temper.

programme.title: The Guy For This
programme.desc: Jimmy's business enters uncharted territory. Kim's confidence is tested when she's faced with a legal problem only she can solve. Nacho navigates increased pressure from Gus. Mike continues to spiral.

programme.title: Namaste
programme.desc: As Jimmy doubles down on “Saul Goodman,” a deeply conflicted Kim brings him an interesting proposition. Gus makes a sacrifice in order to play the long game. Mike attempts to smooth things over with his family.

programme.title: Dedicado A Max
programme.desc: Mike takes an impromptu trip. As she and Jimmy grow closer over their campaign to help a client, Kim makes a surprising call.

programme.title: Wexler V. Goodman
programme.desc: Kim tries to pump the brakes on Jimmy's latest scheme, but it may be too late to stop Saul; Mike turns the heat up on Lalo; Nacho attempts to enlist support from above.

programme.title: Jmm
programme.desc: Jimmy and Kim build a legal firewall with help from Huell; Kim sets things straight with her clients as Jimmy is compromised by his; Gus calms troubled waters in service of his plot to build an empire; Mike does damage control.

programme.title: The Divide
programme.desc: Nick and Lulu square off over the adoption that will split up two brothers; Jake struggles to find a way to keep his parents from losing their house.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E07 Stage 7 - FINLAND - 2024 - World record breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E15 Stage 15 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 1
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E16 Stage 16 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 2
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 10, Hungary
programme.desc: The 10th stage takes place in Hungary and features new super talent!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 11, Zambia
programme.desc: The first ever SCL in Zambia! The athletes get to take in some of the stunning sights and go on to do events such as Tyre Flip and Log Lift

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 12, Romania
programme.desc: The competition moves to Romania and for the first time this season the athletes compete in rainy conditions which make the events even tougher

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 13, Lithunia
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition takes place in Lithunia and world records are once again broken!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 14, Estonia
programme.desc: Episode 14 takes place in Estonia where drama and world records will be seen again

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 15, Malaysia (World Finals Part 1)
programme.desc: Taking place over 2 days in Malaysia, this is part 1 of the world finals of Strongman Champions League!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 16, Malaysia (World Finals Part 2)
programme.desc: Who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League - we find out who is crowned as world champion today in the second part of the final epsiode

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 3, Holland
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 4, Finland
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 5, Bulgaria
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 6, Latvia
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 7, Croatia
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 8, Poland
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 9, Austria
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 10, Romania
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 11, World Log Lift Championship
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 12, Lithuania
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 13, Portugal
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E14 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 14, Martinique
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E15 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 15, Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E16 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 16, World Finals Turkey
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 1, Norway - World strongest Viking
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E02 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E03 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 3, Lithuania - Log lift World championship

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: Set in New Orleans, this is the story of a mysterious man, Nick Easter. Nick gets himself not only on the jury of a landmark case against a gun manufacturer, but as the foreman, in an attempt to influence the other jury members to vote a certain way.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Two strangers who drunkenly got married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot after having their annulment denied by a judge.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: In the not too distant future, a drifter travelling through the desert discovers the largest gold nugget ever found. He must guard it from thieves amid harsh conditions and wild dogs while waiting for his partner to return.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: A hard-working small business owner and his two associates travel to Europe to close the most important deal of their lives. But what began as a routine business trip goes off the rails in every imaginable – and unimaginable – way...

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: A cop turns con man once he comes out of the closet. Once imprisoned, he meets the second love of his life, whom he'll stop at nothing to be with.

programme.title: 24 Hours In London
programme.desc: After 10 years in prison, a killer seeks revenge for his sister’s murder, launching a 24-hour rampage with allies he trusts. As bodies pile up, a detective races to uncover the truth, facing pressure from above. 24 Little Hours is a gripping British crime thriller.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles)?

programme.title: The Duke
programme.desc: When the faithful canine companion to the Duke of Dingwall, Hubert, inherits the Duke’s estate, he teams up with the Butler’s niece to fend off some greedy family members.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: Set in New Orleans, this is the story of a mysterious man, Nick Easter. Nick gets himself not only on the jury of a landmark case against a gun manufacturer, but as the foreman, in an attempt to influence the other jury members to vote a certain way.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: When Arthur and Martha find that their pension pot is virtually worthless they decide to take drastic action by robbing a bank! After their first robbery is successful they start to like the criminal lifestyle, but as the robberies get riskier will they be able to outwit the police as they close in?

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

programme.title: Away From Her
programme.desc: A double-Oscar-nominated, beautifully subtle exploration of Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

programme.title: One Night In Miami…
programme.desc: This powerful film is a fictional account of one incredible night where American icons Muhammad Ali (Eli Goree), Malcolm X (Kingsley Ben-Adir), Sam Cooke (Leslie Odom Jr.), and Jim Brown (Aldis Hodge) gathered, discussing their roles in the civil rights movement and cultural upheaval of the 1960s.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: An up-and-coming district attorney takes on the case of a young woman who has accused three men of sexual assault. She puts her career on the line in order to uncover a deeper web of mystery, murder and deception.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Based on the true story of one of Miami’s most notorious businessmen and gangster's, SPEED KILLS is a high-octane thriller, described as “The Wolf of Wall Street on Water.”

programme.title: Coming home in the dark
programme.desc: A family's outing descends into terror when teacher Alan Hoaganraad, his wife Jill and stepsons Maika and Jordon explore an isolated coastline. An unexpected meeting with a pair of drifters thrusts the family into a nightmare when they find themselves captured.

programme.title: Programming will resume shortly
programme.desc: We're catching up on our beauty sleep! Stay tuned for more priceless entertainment curated by Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Undercover Agent Malcolm Turner is back and this time he's out to expose the suspected designer of a deadly computer "worm" that would allow outside forces access to sophistical and critical government intelligence files.

programme.title: She's The Man
programme.desc: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

programme.title: The Legend Of Hercules
programme.desc: In the epic origin story the legend of Hercules, a half-god, half-man blessed with extraordinary streng. Betrayed by his stepfather, the king, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Escaped convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) are on the run and out of money.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Celebrated and adored by millions, she was the Queen of people’s hearts, yet the bittersweet story of the last man to truly capture hers has never before. In a story that until now has remained untold, Diana introduces a time in the Princess’s life that was important in shaping her final years...

programme.title: Mary and The Witch's Flower
programme.desc: Young Mary follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest and discovers an old broomstick and the strange Fly-by-Night flower, a rare plant that blossoms once every seven years. Together, the flower and the broomstick whisk Mary above the clouds, and far away to Endor College, a school of magic...

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: The Flowers Of War
programme.desc: An American, trapped amidst the Japanese invasion of Nanking in 1937, seeks refuge in a church with a group of schoolchildren and courtesans.

programme.desc: An elite Navy SEAL (Michael B. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.
